title: What’s new
changes: Added optional NASA FIRMS satellite hotspots to the live map, with server-side caching and an independent layer switch.
Added an optional NPWS incident source with automatic folding into matching RFS incidents.
Redesigned incident map popups with warning status, incident details, units paged and a direct incident-timeline action.
Added configurable stop-message correlation so short cancellation pages can join the correct incident timeline.
Improved RFS and VRA incident correlation using shared incident numbers and addresses.
Added a dedicated Fire and Rescue NSW agency icon and normalised agency-logo sizing.
Administrators can now protect their accounts with authenticator-app two-factor authentication and recovery codes.
Added the Bushfire theme and theme-aware Operations Display.
Added selectable PWA icons and neutral link previews.
Added a configurable watermarked login background.
Made push notifications open the matching capcode feed.
Added search to the push-notification capcode picker.
Grouped push-notification controls into a clearer admin settings panel.
Added automatic local service health and admin-managed remote receivers.
Redesigned the admin dashboard and grouped all settings into consistent panels.
